A delivery van costing ₹10,70,000 has accumulated depreciation of ₹4,58,500 after 2 years. Find its book value.

Assertion (A): Under the straight-line method, a photocopier costing ₹5,95,000 with life 8 years and scrap ₹69,000 is depreciated by ₹65,750 every year.
Reason (R): The straight-line method charges equal depreciation (C − S)/n each year.
Choose the correct option.
items.answer: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
options: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A.
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
A is true, but R is false.
A is false, but R is true.

items.stem: Prepare a depreciation schedule (straight-line method) for a air conditioner costing ₹17,35,000 with a useful life of 5 years and scrap value ₹85,000.
items.answer: year 1: depreciation ₹3,30,000, accumulated ₹3,30,000, book value ₹14,05,000; year 2: depreciation ₹3,30,000, accumulated ₹6,60,000, book value ₹10,75,000; year 3: depreciation ₹3,30,000, accumulated ₹9,90,000, book value ₹7,45,000; year 4: depreciation ₹3,30,000, accumulated ₹13,20,000, book value ₹4,15,000; year 5: depreciation ₹3,30,000, accumulated ₹16,50,000, book value ₹85,000
items.markingKey: Annual depreciation (1735000 − 85000)/5 = 330000 (1 mark); accumulated depreciation and book value each year (3 marks); final book value equals scrap value ₹85,000 (1 mark).
